distinctions: The20545 request says owned native browser tab;20635 interprets native acceptance as Google Chrome and separately records owned in-app browser checks. This is an acceptance-surface ambiguity, not evidence of a product rendering failure.

20880 prospectively names owned available browser includingin-app, sameoriginlivepages/fullinteractions, and separately labels old nativeChrome acceptance unperformed. Its rollout is only claimed20881, not accepted.
